newsitem.title: USA: Dresser Industries says has positive outlook.
newsitem.headline: Dresser Industries says has positive outlook.

text.p: Dresser Industries Inc said Wednesday its outlook is positive based on order flow and project awards.

The company said activity levels across the oil and gas industry are high and during the second quarter it booked significant new business, including a major liquified natural gas project. Dresser said its overall backlog rose to a record $5.3 billion.
The company reported earnings for the second quarter of $74.8 million, or $0.42 per share, compared to earnings of $57.1, or $0.31 per share, for the same period a year ago.
